reasoning_steps: Step 1: Point charge +Q at center of square base of pyramid.
Step 2: Reflect across base to form closed regular 8-faced octahedron.
Step 3: Total flux through closed octahedron by Gauss's Law is Q / eps_0.
Step 4: By symmetry across all 8 identical triangular faces, flux per face is Q / (8 eps_0).
assumptions_used: Charge at exact center of base in planar interface
diagram_interpretation: Square pyramid with base side a and charge +Q at base center.
